scope: Curvature continuation of the reference clearance corridor past the measured rail anchors. The corridor previously continued along a straight tangent whose slope was clipped at rail_max_heading and was modelled for path_max_extrapolation_m beyond the nearest anchor; on a curve the true centre-line leaves that line quadratically.

problem_measurement.modelled_horizon_m: anchors + path_max_extrapolation_m (25 m) = about 65 m on real recordings

bore_evidence_range_m.note: Walls/ceiling return far beyond the rails, but per-bin medians of upper returns are not an axis: in roundT frame 180 the left/right pairing jumps from a 5.0 m to a 9.0 m separation (platform edge versus bore wall). A long-lever estimator must use surface strips, not medians.

change.off_switch: path_curve_window_m: 0 reproduces the previous straight continuation
properties: fit expressed in the edge anchor frame, so center(x) is continuous there
curvature shrunk to zero unless |c| exceeds path_curvature_significance standard errors
extrapolation uncertainty propagated from the fit covariance in quadrature with the base term
the 25 m gate and every threshold are unchanged

forward_prediction_test.method: Predict the centre-line ahead from frame k, express that world point in the axes of a later frame that has driven over the same ground, and compare with the rails it measures there. Label-free; the reference is the sensor's own later measurement.
forward_prediction_test.recording: roundT_doubleT, 11 source frames, poses from build/perf-cpp-opt-20260917

off_switch_reproduction.note: with path_curve_window_m=0 the new column equals the old model

measured_pattern_panel.note: rails are straight boxes across the whole scene, so any bend the fit invents is error

doubleT_obstacle_straight.note: one frame of 60 moves unresolved_obstacle -> candidate; labels cannot adjudicate it

trade_offs_stated: This makes the corridor follow the curve inside its modelled horizon; it does not extend that horizon. Beyond anchors + 25 m there is still no modelled coverage, so the 100-300 m band the organizers score remains unknown until a long-lever (bore) estimate justifies modelling there.

On straight track the fitted slope replaces the noisy two-point tangent, which changes the corridor slightly: doubleT_obstacle moved 64 -> 70 intersecting object observations out of 14,305. Smoother is the intent, but it is a behaviour change and no label exists to call it an improvement.
The 2 sigma shrinkage keeps the straight continuation for a genuinely gentle curve that a 30 m window cannot resolve. Under-bending, never over-bending.
Uncertainty is now the old base term in quadrature with the fit error, so it is never smaller than before; in noisy frames that can flip points near the extrapolation edge out of 'observed'.
Curvature still comes from at most 40 m of rail evidence; the fit is a local quadratic, not a clothoid, and it does not model transition spirals explicitly.

The fitted slope replaces the two-point tangent even where the curvature is shrunk, so straight recordings are not bit-identical either: on 60 frames of doubleT_obstacle one frame's status moves unresolved_obstacle -> candidate and objects fall 14,305 -> 14,169. Keeping the old two-point slope and adding only the fitted curvature would make straight geometry identical; it is not implemented.
rejected: Reusing the previous frame's background or corridor (the project reserves that as an algorithmic experiment with causal requirements; it changes decisions).
Extending the modelled horizon with a curvature fit from rails alone: a 40 m lever implies sigma_curvature about 3-6e-5 1/m, which is 0.3-2.7 m of induced error at 100-300 m.
Estimating the axis from per-bin medians of wall/upper returns: measured to jump 5-9 m with scene content (platform edges), so it would inject the very error it is meant to remove.

mechanism.inside_anchor_span: centre and uncertainty identical to before (checked on a real frame, 5-40 m)
mechanism.consequence: The synthetic false positives are distant background components re-classified by a corridor shift of 5-15 cm beyond 40 m, not the inserted object; recall is unchanged in the 3-case subset and the full panel loses 7 tp at 2 sigma only.
mechanism.determinism: three repeats of the same config gave identical counts, so the deltas are the change, not run noise
